findings.problem: The realQuadratic algebra lemmas (realQuadratic_sub, realQuadratic_add, realQuadratic_hom) are stated for plain `ι → ι → ℝ` and have no simp attribute and no Matrix-typed counterparts. Every client passes `Matrix ι ι ℝ` data, for example `realQuadratic (H t - Q.map Complex.re) v` in the hypothesis `hgap` of phase_matrix_continuation_at. To use `realQuadratic_sub`, the proof therefore eta-expands both matrices into lambdas, rewrites, and then closes the gap with a `change`. The same three-line workaround appears again in PhaseFormMatrix.lean in continuous_real_quadratic_coercive_near. So the interface has no canonical rewrite for `realQuadratic (A - B) v` on Matrix arguments. Each client has to hand-roll the unfolding, and `simp` or `rw` cannot normalise such expressions directly.
findings.proposed_change: In PhaseFormMatrix.lean, add Matrix-typed versions of the lemmas: `realQuadratic (A - B) v = realQuadratic A v - realQuadratic B v` for `A B : Matrix ι ι ℝ`, and the same for add, neg and smul. The proof can reuse the existing `realQuadratic_sub` via `rfl` or `show`. Mark the sub and add versions `@[simp]`, since they strictly decrease the matrix expression inside `realQuadratic`. Then lines 54–58 reduce to `have hab := realQuadratic_abs_bound (A t - A s) v; rw [realQuadratic_sub] at hab`. Only the `change` that folds the `∑ |…|` sum into `variation s` would remain. Alternatively, restate `realQuadratic_abs_bound` and `realQuadratic_sub` over `Matrix ι ι ℝ`.
findings.benefit: The two duplicated proofs, here and in continuous_real_quadratic_coercive_near, no longer need the eta-expanded `(fun i j => …) - (fun i j => …)` and `change` workaround. Statements such as `hgap`, which subtract matrices inside `realQuadratic`, can be normalised with `simp` or `rw`. Future uses on `H t - Q.map re` get a single canonical rewrite instead of repeating the workaround.

evidence.excerpt:
lemma realQuadratic_sub (a b : ι → ι → ℝ) (v : ι → ℝ) :
    realQuadratic (a-b) v = realQuadratic a v - realQuadratic b v := by

have hab := realQuadratic_abs_bound ((fun i j => A t i j) - (fun i j => A s i j)) v
  rw [realQuadratic_sub] at hab
